<issue>
SQL hints are not preserved when using strip_comments=True

Description

When using the strip_comments=True option with sqlparse.format(), SQL hints are being removed instead of preserved. SQL hints are special comments that provide instructions to the query optimizer and should not be stripped.

For example, when formatting this SQL:
```sql
select --+full(u)
```

The output should preserve the hint, but it's being removed.

The same issue happens with other types of SQL hints:
```sql
#+ hint
select * from foo
```

```sql
SELECT /*+cluster(T)*/* FROM T_EEE T where A >:1
```

```sql
insert /*+ DIRECT */ into sch.table_name as select * from foo
```

All of these hints are being incorrectly removed when strip_comments=True is set. This is problematic because SQL hints are important for query optimization and should be preserved even when regular comments are stripped.
</issue>
